newsitem.title: CROATIA: BASKETBALL-CIBONA KEEP UNBEATEN EUROLEAGUE RECORD.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-CIBONA KEEP UNBEATEN EUROLEAGUE RECORD.

text.p: Cibona Zagreb beat Germany's Alba Berlin 78-68 on Thursday to make it three wins from three games in Group B EuroLeague action.

Fifteen out of 32 attempts for three pointers succeeded, swinging the game the Croats' way and recalling memories of the days when the late Drazen Petrovic led the two-time European champions to their greatest successes.

Young Zagreb playmaker Damir Mulaomerovic sank three three-pointers in less than two minutes and veteran point-guard Zdravko Radulovic added another to lift Cibona to 26-16 from 14-14 midway through the first half.

At halftime, after more long-range shooting, Cibona led 46-31 and although the Germans came back to within nine points with a 6-0 spell at the beginning of the second half, another deadly series of three three-pointers from Mulaomerovic put Cibona out of reach.
Mulaomerovic led the scorers with 28 points, with a 6-8 record for three-pointers.
